questions.stemHtml: Mechanical nociceptors and its response to a probe with blunt object, pinprick and toothed forceps with serrations is recorded as an output of a force transducer coupled to the stimulator. What could be inferred from this? {{caption_text}}

options.label: A
options.text: There are no responses from the nociceptors when stimulated by blunt forceps

options.label: B
options.text: Pinching with toothed forceps cause stimulation of mechanonociceptors but no pain

options.label: C
options.text: Pricking with a needle does not stimulate nociceptors

options.label: D
options.text: Sharp pain sensation is carried by C fibres
